code.text: COAG
PANEL.MICRO

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows severe hypoxemia and acidemia, with low hemoglobin, erythrocytes, hematocrit, and platelets, suggesting anemia and thrombocytopenia. There is mild leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, monocytosis, and elevated ferritin and LDH, indicating possible inflammation or tissue damage. Hypoproteinemia is present. INR is markedly elevated, suggesting coagulopathy. No evidence of acute myocardial injury or COVID-19 infection. Findings are consistent with severe respiratory failure, anemia, and possible underlying systemic or hematologic disorder; urgent clinical evaluation is recommended.
